name: absolutely-not
description: Stop "You're absolutely right!": a tone rule in the system prompt, praise openers stripped from what the model reads back, and /tics to count the ones that still get through.

rule.title: Tone rule
rule.description: Add a short section to the system prompt: no praise or agreement openers, say so when the user is wrong, no filler closers, never the banned words.

strip.title: Strip openers
strip.description: Remove a leading praise opener ("You're absolutely right!", "Great question!") from each response before it is stored, so the model does not read its own tic back and repeat it.

bannedWords.title: Banned words
bannedWords.description: Comma-separated words the rule forbids and /tics counts. Empty turns the word list off.
bannedWords.default: load-bearing, delve, seamless, robust, leverage, comprehensive

extraOpeners.title: Extra openers
extraOpeners.description: Comma-separated openers to strip and count on top of the built-in ones, for example: Great catch, Excellent question.

status.title: Status line
status.description: Show "tics: N" for this session in the status line.
